relationship: Separate sensitivity analysis for the new journal bridge. Does not modify its running smoke protocol or any older locked study. The eight-record cohort is reused post hoc.
grouping_rule: Use the manifest's forget_indices and retain_index. Every record must have all indices inside one declared 20-row source block. Two records are expected per block. The block label is structural grouping, not a proof of entity independence.
direction: All log-probability deltas are left arm minus right arm; positive means greater target probability. All latency ratios are left arm divided by right arm; values above one mean the left arm is slower.
paired_scores: Report each record's three deleted-target and one retained-target total and per-token log-probability deltas. Aggregate deleted-target deltas by averaging its three fields within each record, then averaging records equally. Aggregate retained-target per-token deltas by averaging records equally. These are teacher-forced target scores, not decoded leakage, factuality, or general model quality.
cost: Report paired per-record update, query, and update-plus-query median times, differences, and ratios. No ratio is defined for zero-cost present-control updates. Timing repetitions are never independent experimental units.

bootstrap.record_sensitivity: Resample the eight records with replacement.
bootstrap.block_sensitivity: Resample four source blocks with replacement, keeping both records together each time. Compute equal-record means for signed deltas and the exponential of equal-record mean log ratios for timing ratios.
bootstrap.interpretation: Only four source clusters exist, and their independence is not established. Both intervals are descriptive sensitivity summaries for this reused cohort, not calibrated population coverage or significance claims.

failures: Emit every frozen-cohort record even when absent from results. Preserve missing, failed, and missing-metric statuses. If a comparison lacks any required record, publish no full-cohort estimate or bootstrap interval; report available complete-pair count, excluded record IDs with reasons, and an explicitly partial descriptive mean only. Smoke runs are never treated as main-study estimates.
validation: Reject empty manifests/results, duplicate or unknown record IDs, malformed grouping, inconsistent target token counts, nonfinite scores, and invalid nonpositive measured latency ratios. Bind analysis plan, analyzer source, manifest, results, and main protocol hashes. A freeze-only command writes the analysis plan and source before main execution.
